item.title: Warren County Records: Marriage licenses, warranty deeds, and deeds of trust from Jan. 28 to Feb. 3, 2026
item.description: Warren County recorded marriage licenses, warranty deeds, and deeds of trust from Jan. 27 to Feb. 3, 2026, detailing recent unions and property transactions across the area.

item.title: Stacked with tradition: It's time for Christ Episcopal Church's annual pancake supper
item.description: Christ Episcopal Church’s 140-year pancake supper tradition returns Feb. 17, 5–7:30 p.m., with pancakes, a sweets-and-soups table, cake raffle and all proceeds benefiting local charities.

item.title: Old Post Files: A look back over the last 100 years on Feb. 7, 2026
item.description: Old Post Files is a regular feature within the pages of The Vicksburg Post's print edition and digital e-edition. This feature looks back at some of the happenings from the pages of The Vicksburg Post over the past 100 years. Enjoy.

item.title: FERGUSON: Ice storm blessings
item.description: It’s early, early Saturday morning as I write this in peaceful solitude. It’s quiet. Coffee is good. And better yet, we still have power. I don’t expect to be able to say that for the rest of the weekend.

item.title: Hunters' Hall of Fame: Trip Irwin
item.description: HUNTERS' HALL OF FAME: Trip Irwin, an 11-year-old Vicksburg resident, got his first buck.

item.title: Who's Hot: John Austin White
item.description: Porter’s Chapel Academy soccer goal keeper John Austin White helped the Eagles win their season finale on Monday.

item.title: OUTLOOK: Style takes a seat at BTS Bash
item.description: More than 300 locals and visitors turned out for the Vicksburg Beautiful Table Settings Bash, highlighted by guest speakers, shopping and a new table-setting competition.

item.title: The future of the docks: Maritime day connects students with industry partners
item.description: Maritime Interaction Day in Vicksburg gives students and educators hands-on exposure to river, maritime and logistics careers through local industry partners and activities.

item.title: TEACHER OF THE YEAR: Ghrigsby fosters communication skills at Redwood Elementary
item.description: Redwood Elementary teacher Torri Ghrigsby, an Educator of the Year nominee, builds students' communication skills with 'Bucket Filling' and Pre-K buddy mentoring.

item.title: MHSAA Region 2-6A and 2-5A basketball tournament schedules
item.description: Warren Central will host the MHSAA Region 2-6A basketball tournament this week, and Vicksburg will go to Jackson for the 2-5A tournament. Check out the schedules for both tournaments.
